szoveg_eredeti:
As part of Warren County’s ongoing “Let’s Talk Warren County” series, Warren County is hosting a special community event, Let’s Talk AI, on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM at the Warren County Memorial Library in Warrenton.

The event was planned and sponsored by Warren County staff and the Board of Commissioners and will give the community an opportunity to educate themselves on the history, evolution, and current landscape of Artificial Intelligence (AI). This event is an opportunity to get facts about AI and enhance awareness for the use of AI in everyday life and in the future.

The event features a guest speaker, Robert Hiett, who is the Executive Director of the Upper Coastal Plains Council of Governments. He is an expert in the world of AI, especially from a governmental perspective, and brings years of public speaking experience. At the end of Mr. Hiett’s presentation, time is allotted for a community question and answer session. So bring your questions and your notebooks and hear about how AI affects both you and Warren County.

About Warren County Government: The mission of the Warren County Board of Commissioners is to provide leadership and support for an effective county government that seeks to enhance the quality of life for the people of Warren County.
